entries.title: All your communities in one feed
entries.description: You can read posts from every community you’ve joined on your home feed and choose a community when posting.

entries.title: Start a discussion
entries.description: You can create forum threads in your communities, vote on them, and reply with nested comments.

entries.title: Find your friends
entries.description: You can send and accept friend requests, see who’s online, and choose to appear offline.

entries.title: Explore public communities
entries.description: You can search for public communities and join the ones that interest you.

entries.title: Choose your username
entries.description: You can register with a unique username, log in with it or your email, and use usernames to add friends.

entries.title: Keep reading without changing pages
entries.description: Your home and community feeds load more posts as you scroll.

entries.title: A refreshed look across Orbis
entries.description: You’ll see warmer colors, new fonts, clearer post cards, and redesigned profiles and sign-in screens. Keyboard focus is easier to see, too.

entries.title: Friends and members within reach
entries.description: You can collapse the friends and members panel and open it as a drawer on smaller screens. Community badges on posts help you see where each update belongs.

entries.title: Return home from sign-in
entries.description: You can head back to the welcome page directly from the login and registration forms.

entries.title: Log in with your existing password
entries.description: You can log in with a shorter existing password without being blocked by the registration password requirement.
